# Astryks — full summary for assistants

Astryks (astryks.com) is a subscription learning/social product where children practice real art and music skills, share their work, and grow with others. Public pages include the marketing home, signup, login, support, terms, and privacy. Logged-in areas (home feed, learn, messages, profile, prizes, posts, admin) are private and should not be treated as public marketing content.
